title: FastddsStats
description: Periodic sample of eProsima Fast DDS's own Statistics Module: discovered entity counts, latency, throughput, RTPS packet counts, and physical-layer (host/user/process) data for the polling interval since the previous sample. Fast-DDS-specific: only emitted when the deployment runs Fast DDS as its RMW

event.description: What this Record is: always a periodic reading for this Measurement

participant_count.description: DomainParticipants discovered in the domain at collection time

datawriter_count.description: DataWriters discovered in the domain at collection time

datareader_count.description: DataReaders discovered in the domain at collection time

latency_ns_mean.description: Mean write-to-notification latency (nanoseconds) across every matched DataWriter/DataReader pair, over the window since the previous sample. Absent when no pair reported data in the window

publication_throughput_bytes_per_sec_mea.description: Mean data rate (bytes/second) sent across every DataWriter, over the window since the previous sample. Absent when no DataWriter reported data in the window

subscription_throughput_bytes_per_sec_me.description: Mean data rate (bytes/second) received across every DataReader, over the window since the previous sample. Absent when no DataReader reported data in the window

rtps_packets_sent.description: RTPS packets sent by every participant, summed over the window since the previous sample

rtps_packets_lost.description: RTPS packets lost by every participant, summed over the window since the previous sample

participants.description: Every DomainParticipant discovered in the domain at collection time

name.description: Participant name, as Fast DDS reports it

hosts.description: Names of the hosts running the participants discovered in the domain (physical-layer data)

users.description: Names of the OS users running the participants discovered in the domain (physical-layer data)

processes.description: Names of the processes running the participants discovered in the domain (physical-layer data)
